Game Overview

In Teddy Bear Zombies Machine Gun, the core idea is straightforward: survive the zany onslaught of adorable yet deadly teddy bear zombies. Test your reflexes in fast-paced levels and outsmart increasingly fierce plush foes. Upgrade your hero to endure endless waves and discover just how sinister these cuddly invaders can be. Are you ready for the huggable horror?
